limitations: Exactly eight listed images were visually opened once each. No original whole image was opened, and no image was reopened, cropped, recaptured or transformed.
Only supplied offline artifacts were assessed. The actual interaction was read from its bound receipt, not rerun or performed by this reviewer.
The horizontal access evidence is pointer-wheel input in mobile-sized HTML ONLY. No touch, keyboard, focus-navigation, assistive-technology or full accessibility certification is implied.

The initial and terminal formula states each hide part of the expression at opposite edges. Readability is validated across those states with actual scrolling, not as simultaneous no-scroll fit or a newly repaired reflow.

Six focused captures sample representative answer/choice labels and formula glyphs. The overall eight questions and 32 options rely on the prior whole review; offscreen rows in focused captures are not newly inspected.
The original whole-review REVISE and seven original PASS observations remain preserved as historical evidence. Reusing observations does not reopen or extend their original legibility scopes.

Original text, math and CSS were not changed. The same HTML hash and identical before/after TeX support unchanged interaction evidence; this reviewer wrote only this review artifact and made no repair.
No new substantive mathematical, scientific, translation or English-content approval.
